title: Big Bang Evidence: CMB and Beyond
welcome_lead: Hear the 2.7 K hiss of the cosmic microwave background and count primordial elements.
meta_desc: A-Level Cosmology adventure on Big Bang evidence including CMB and light element abundances.
final_note: Three independent pillars: expansion, CMB and light-element abundances.

concepts.def: Hot, dense early universe expanding outwards.
Formation of H, He, Li in first minutes.
~25% by mass — matches Big Bang prediction.

walkthroughs.body_html: Hot photons from 380,000 years after Big Bang have been redshifted to microwave wavelengths. Black body at 2.725 K, nearly uniform — a smoking gun for the Big Bang.
Big Bang nucleosynthesis predicts ~75% H, ~25% He, trace Li by mass. Observations of pristine clouds match remarkably — strong support for hot early universe.
1) Hubble expansion. 2) CMB at 2.7 K. 3) Primordial light-element abundances. Together they make Big Bang the consensus model.
